terminal_name: Argentina LNG Terminal (Phase 1.1 / 1.2, Golfo San Matias / Punta Colorada, Rio Negro)
issue: Confirmed via trade press (econojournal.com.ar, Lmneuquen.com, ArgenPorts, Shale24, Infobae -- Aug 2025 to Aug 2026) that the consortium widely branded 'Southern Energy S.A.' (Pan American Energy + YPF + Golar + Harbour Energy + Pampa Energia) IS the same project already tracked in GEM as 'Argentina LNG Terminal' Phase 1.1 (Golar Hilli Episeyo FLNG) and Phase 1.2 (Golar MK II FLNG) at -41.11535, -65.08253. PAE's own RIGI filing (~US$2.9-3.0bn, approved 2024-11) and the 'Southern Energy' RIGI approval (2025-05) both describe this same vessel pair and dedicated pipeline/gasoducto to San Antonio Este -- not a separate project. Hilli Episeyo departed Cameroon Aug 2026 en route to Argentina; MK II is in shipyard modernization (Seatrium, confirmed Mar 2026). No new terminal staged -- this is update-agent-relevant corroboration, not a discovery.
suggested_action: Update agent for Argentina: consider adding 'Southern Energy S.A.' as an OtherNames/alias and citing the RIGI approval + Hilli Episeyo transit news as fresh corroboration/refs for Phase 1.1/1.2 status and vessel assignment (Golar Hilli Episeyo now confirmed en route as of Aug 2026, not just contracted).
